description.narrative: Government at national and sub-national level have strengthened capacity to deliver integrated social protection services, including goods and cash, to the most deprived families, as well as in support of families, including children on the move, during acute emergency and recovery, in line with the CCCs.

title.narrative: UNICEF supported 59,447 households  composed of 493,410 individuals (224,501 adults and 268,909 children) , in Afghanistan with social protection interventions, including humanitarian and social cash assistance, benefiting the most vulnerable households, households with pregnant and lactating women and children under 2 years, female-headed households, households with disabled children and households headed by disabled persons.
